note: Articulation hints for assets.model(id). Scale suggestions are authored game sizes, not measured real-world dimensions. Forward is measured from named front-wheel positions where available.

car-concept.note: Spin groups contain rims, tyres and discs; brake pads remain in the steering assembly. Source door pivots are retained.

v12-goblin.note: Source tyre/rim children and separate brake branches retained. No interior.

gourami-saloon.note: Car is 0.406 units long after mirror normalization; scale 12.5 gives a proposed 5.08 m saloon. Wheel material meshes combine multiple wheels.

coupeox.note: Long axis X; scale 4.8 gives a proposed 4.8 m concept coupe. Source objects are separated by material, not four wheel pivots.

offroad-buggy.note: Long axis Z; scale 3.2 gives a proposed 3.2 m buggy. All four tyres share 1 BAN; do not rotate that mesh as one wheel.
